answer: A speed skating club tenure with lap time records works as the gate: lap times recorded at one rink for years. Each of 226 aliases needs its own lap records, and the years behind each one make bulk forgery cost more than the reward. The prism test is the price tag: 226 fakes mean 226 payments. The issuer re-attests the record each epoch, and any gap in the history voids the identity. The grove signal is visible to every grader, and the wharf ledger is what makes the farm's arithmetic fail.
